When it is in the south of the sky, you are in the northern hemisphere. When it is hidden by cloud, you are, in the technical sense, fu**ed. Today's sky has been cleared for you at considerable expense. Don't forget, the red needle points north, some trainees needed this to be explained not to name any names … Frank.
